capabilities: Sync edits between devices in real time
Encrypt notes on the device before upload
Keep note version history and recently deleted notes
extras: Work in progress tested only by the author; README advises keeping a vault backup. Free on Cloudflare's free plan, Workers Paid $5/month for heavier use. Open source under MIT; built with AI. Setup, security and protocol details live on ownsync.dev.
motivation: The author wanted notes on laptop and phone, in sync while typing, without handing them to anyone.
problem: Syncing notes between devices usually means handing their contents to a third-party service.

relations.evidence: Ownsync runs on a free Cloudflare Worker in your own account.

summary: End-to-end encrypted real-time vault sync that runs on your own Cloudflare Worker, with keys kept on your devices.
